app.name: isd
app.one_liner: A keyboard-focused, highly customizable TUI for managing systemd units with fuzzy search, auto-refreshing previews, and dynamic theming.

screens.name: Settings Panel
screens.purpose: Configure keybindings, themes, and application behavior via YAML or UI controls.

screens.name: Unit Browser
screens.purpose: Display and interact with systemd units in a searchable, filterable list with real-time preview.
primary_actions: Execute systemctl commands (start, stop, enable, etc.)
Open unit details or logs in pager/editor

rust_commands.name: apply_theme
rust_commands.purpose: Load and apply a selected theme, including experimental terminal-derived themes based on TERM environment inspection.

rust_commands.name: execute_systemctl_action
rust_commands.purpose: Run a systemctl command on a selected unit, automatically prefixing with sudo if required by permissions.

rust_commands.name: switch_unit_scope
rust_commands.purpose: Toggle between system-wide and user-specific systemd units.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add basic theme selection (including terminal-derived)
week 1: Implement core unit listing with fuzzy search
week 1: Integrate auto-sudo logic for privileged operations
acceptance_tests: Global configuration file at /etc/xdg/isd_tui/config.yaml is loaded and overridden by local config.
Initial search term can be passed via CLI argument (pending implementation).
Text in Cat tab is selectable and copyable after fix.
Theme respects terminal color scheme when using terminal-derived-theme in supported emulators like kitty.
User can switch between system and user units without restarting the app.
